title: Bluegrass
style: [Bluegrass gospel, guitar, banjo, folk, fast pace, banjo, violin, mostly banjo and violin
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Gold tower grin
All teeth and glare
Shouting
“I’m the chosen
” like a county fair
Signs and wonders on a TV screen
Crowds cry out
“He’s the king
He’s mean!”

Talks big peace while he stirs up war
Boasts in himself like a bragging lore
Loves that praise like a holy seat
Wants every knee bow down at his feet

[Chorus]
Is he that man of sin we read?
King James words in crimson bleed
Boastful horn in a suit and tie
Lifting his name
Lifting a lie
If the shoe fits
Let it ring
Seven-string banjo starts to sing
“Son of perdition
Proud and bright”
Tell me
Is Trump the Antichrist?

[Verse 2]
Daniel saw beasts with the iron jaw
John saw pride dressed up as law
Great swelling words
That flattering tongue
Fires up the base
Has the young ones sung

Loves strong delusion
Hates the truth
Bends every line
Twists every proof
“Make it great
” while the weak get burned
Scripture on the shelf
But his name gets turned

[Chorus]

[Bridge]
False signs
False spin
False faith
Fake throne
Image on the banner
Name carved in stone
Lifting up a man where the Lord should stand
Mark it in the margin
Bible in your hand

[Chorus]
